|strategy=By [mailto:joea@decipher.com Joe Alread Decipher Intern]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/aimhigh.html</ref>

The long awaited counterpart to [[Secret Plans (Dark){{!}}Secret Plans]], [[Aim High]] finally gives those heavy Dark Side retrieval decks some problems of its own. This effect will probably be most useful against non-unique decks and [[Bounty]] Hunter decks, i.e. decks that retrieve Force in large amounts all at once. Don't forget it's offensive capability as well, to get power +5 whenever you fire two weapons in a battle can be extremely powerful, especially if EPP [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] and [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] start firing their blasters in tandem.
|combos=* [[Aim High]] + [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]] + [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]] Power 12 if they both do fire their weapon and two battle destinies.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Aim%20High</ref>
|rulings=* Dark has the option to decline and cancel the retrieval.<ref name="scomp" />
* The amount of Force used ('X') equals the retrieval amount initiated, even if the Lost pile has fewer than X cards.
* If Dark is to search their Lost Pile to retrieve card(s) that meet specific criteria, Dark searches first, then pays for [[Aim High]] only if they find valid card(s) and choose to retrieve.
